build_transformer_predictor: build a transformer predictor using TransformerConfig and Haiku for JAX-based sequence modeling
create_transformer_decoder: create a transformer decoder with SwiGLU MLP, multi-head attention, and causal masking for autoregressive generation
create_multihead_attention: create a multi-head dot-product attention module with optional QK layer normalization for transformer blocks
create_positional_encodings: create sinusoidal or learned positional encodings for transformer sequence inputs
create_transformer_config: create a TransformerConfig dataclass with hyperparameters for embedding dim, layers, heads, and positional encoding type
